messages:
Maria: Quick check — I opened quota request #Q-12345 for us-east4 H100 quota bump (for Dedicated pool canary). Vendor says partial manifest ETA Tue morning. Can we land canary Tue 09:00 PT? Also tagging @Tina for cost approval.

Raj: What's the exact quota number and region? I need it to update infra/quotas.yml and open the TF PR.

Maria: Request details:
```
provider: gcp
project: redwood-prod
region: us-east4
quota_metric: NVIDIA_H100_GPUS
requested_increase: 40
ticket: Q-12345
```
Also ran `gcloud compute regions describe us-east4 --project=redwood-prod --format='json(quotas)' | jq '.[] | select(.metric==\"NVIDIA_H100_GPUS\")'`

OpsBot: Quota request Q-12345 submitted to vendor portal — status: pending (vendor acknowledgement required).

Sam-Vendor: We have Q-12345 on our side. Manifest tentative: 1 rack H100 (8 GPUs/rack), 2 racks L40s (16 GPUs/rack) to be staged Tue 06:00 PT -> arrival Tue 08:30 PT. Need confirmation for on-site networking and rack install window.

Kyle: @Tina FYI — rough cost delta for Dedicated reserved capacity with that mix is ~ $9k/mo. Can finance absorb in Q2 burst budget?

Tina: We can cover up to $10k/month from burst contingency. Please keep DA ticket with final SKU breakdown. Approve provisional spend.

Helen: If we're landing Tue canary, we should bump autoscaler min_replica_count and reserved_capacity in infra. Draft patch:
```
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "canary" {
  region = "us-east4"
  reserved_capacity = 24
}
```
Can someone review? I don't want to oversubscribe the burst plan.

Raj: I'll carve out a small PR to `infra/quotas.yml` + `infra/pools.tf`. Will link here when ready.

Maria: Thanks. @Sam-Vendor — please cc us when manifest is finalized. I'll plan canary start Tue 09:00 PT if install completes by 08:30. :thumbsup:

Sam-Vendor: Will confirm manifest by EOD today and update tracking number.

Maria: Great — leaving this thread for async updates. If Raj posts PR I'll do a quick smoke test once infra applies. /cc @Helen
